text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} runs into Mitsuki while out in town.
text_block_list.orig_text: 街を歩いていた{0}は、ミツキと出会う。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Hello there... Oh my, you're looking quite pale.
Are you all right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちは……
って君、
顔色が良くないわよ。
大丈夫……？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
You're losing sleep because of work? I see... That's too bad.
But remember, your body is also a valuable test subject,
so I can't have you wantonly abusing it. I kid, I kid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕事で寝不足……？　
そう、
大変なのね。
だけど
君の身体は
私の実験台でもあるんだから、
酷使するのは、
いただけないわね……
なんてね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
I'm actually working on a magic spell right now.
Let me use it to fix you up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょうど開発中の魔法があるから、
それで回復してあげる。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Oh, don't worry. No need to be afraid.
This magic is safe. The first test subject is standing
right in front of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたの？　
ああ、
大丈夫。
怯えなくていいわ。
この魔法は安全よ。
最初の実験台がここにいるんだから。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
I haven't felt well-rested in a while lately,
so I've been researching a new spell to help me
feel more refreshed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最近どうにも疲れが取れなくなってきたから、
魔法で解決しちゃおうと思って、
近頃はこの魔法を研究してたの。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
It promotes healing in your body and suppresses
the causes of fatigue. It took me quite a while to get
the technique just right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
疲労を感じる原因を抑えながら、
体に回復するよう促すのよ。
術式を確定させるのが結構大変で……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Oh look, I think the spell is already doing its job.
Try moving around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
説明してる間に回復出来たみたい。
すこし動いてみて。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
See? It worked, didn't it?
Sounds like this experiment was a great success.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ね？　
疲れが取れたでしょ？
疲労を取り除く魔法、
開発成功ね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, it's nice to hear some genuine gratitude.
Well then, while we're here, shall I throw in a little bonus?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
素直にお礼を言われるのも、
いいものね。
それじゃあおまけに、
別の魔法もかけていい？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Don't panic, don't panic. It's not going to kill you. 
If anything, you might even feel extra recharged!
Well then, here goes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
慌てなくても大丈夫。
命を取るような魔法じゃないわ。
むしろ、
余計に元気になっちゃうかも？　
いくわよ！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Energies mine, make this man the object of all desire!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──汝、
今より何人をも魅了せし者となれ！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
That was a spell to boost pheromone secretion and efficacy.
Now, women will find you irresistible.
You won't be able to keep them off of you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のはフェロモンの分泌促進と効果倍増の魔法よ。
女性がみんな君に好意的になって、
君を求めずにはいられなくなる代物なの。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Wondering why I'm not behaving differently?
Well, of course it wouldn't work on me. After all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたの……？　
私に変化がなくて不思議？
私に効果がないのは当然よ。
だって……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I'm already utterly infatuated with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はもう、
君のことが好きなんだもの……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Kidding, kidding!
I'm wearing some special magical accessories
to negate the effects.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……冗談よ♪
私は特製の魔法具を身に着けているから平気なの。

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Um, um... Excuse me, good sir!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、あの！　
ちょっといいですか！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: There, you see? It's working already.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら見て。
早速効果が出たみたいね。

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
I think I've fallen in love with you at first sight!
Please go out with me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
あなたに一目惚れしました！
付き合ってください！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Isn't my magic incredible?
Looks like this experiment was a great success as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうかしら？　
すごいでしょう、この魔法！
実験は滞りなく成功ね♪

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
Hold it!
I saw him before you did. He's mine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ちなさい！
その人に一目惚れしたのは、
私が先だ！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
Who are you?! Actually, it doesn't matter.
I know I'm the one he's going to fall in love with!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰よあなた！　
いいえ、
別にどうでもいいわ。
どうせこの人に愛されるのは私だもの！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, what a pretty sight.
How does it feel to be so popular all of a sudden?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
入れ食いね。
突然人気者になった気分はどう？

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
That young man's heart will be mine alone!
I won't let anyone else have him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その子のハートを射止めるのは、
ワ・タ・シ♪
誰にも渡さないわよ！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Who'd have thought it? That's three suitors already!
And it looks like there are more where they came from...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……これは予想外。
二人どころか三人も。
それどころか向こうから沢山来てるわね……

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Don't go! Please be my boyfriend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃げないでー！　
私の恋人になってー！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
Get out of my way, all of you!
My darling and I are meant to be together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どきなさい、
あなた達！
ダーリンと結ばれるのは、
私なんだから！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: All of you are in my way! Scram already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタたち邪魔よ！　
どきなさいっ！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Just look at them all! This spell is more effective
than I thought. Even men are feeling the effects. 
I'll have some interesting data to look over later!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい数！　
想定よりも効果が出てるわ。
おまけに男性にまで効果が及んでいる。
これは興味深いデータが取れそう。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
I think not.
I'm having far too much fun watching this play out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメよ。
君が逃げ惑うところを見るのも楽しいもの。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
You can handle a little romantic trouble, right?
I want to soak in this sight a little while longer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
君ならもっと頑張れるでしょう？
まだまだ私を喜ばせてちょうだい。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Heavens, no! Then I wouldn't be able to collect any data!
Let's keep this going a while longer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
それじゃあデータが集められないじゃない。
このまま続けるわ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine. I know you have the stamina to handle this.
Go on, you can do this for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫よ。
君ならまだ持ちこたえられるわ。
さぁ、
私のために頑張りなさい。

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Hold on, where are you going? Wait for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どちらへ行かれるのです？　
待ってください！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Come back at once! I can't let you get away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃がすものか！　
もう君を離しはしないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
I want to see how long the spell's effects last,
so you keep running like a good boy! You're doing great! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
どのくらい長く効果が続くか調べたいから、
しばらくそのまま逃げ続けてきてくれない？　
よろしく～！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Please waaait!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待ってくださーい！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh! Why must you run so fast?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～ん！　
そんなに早く逃げないで～！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Where are you running to? Come, leap into my arms!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何処へ行くのですか！　
どうか私の腕の中に！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*...
The more you run, the more I want you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぜぇ……
はぁ……
こんなに逃げられたら、
逆に燃えてきちゃった……！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back! Looks like you got away unscathed. 
And the magic's effects still haven't worn off.
What truly excellent results! Thank you for your sacrifice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかえりなさい。
ちゃんと逃げきれたのね。
まだ魔法の効果が出てるわ……
実験は大成功よ！　
ありがとう♪

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: YOU'RE MINE NOW!
text_block_list.orig_text: 捕まえたー！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
I've finally caught up to you, my darling! ♪
Now, hurry up and press your lips to mine, you fool!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっと追いついたわ、
ダーリン♪
それじゃあ早速、
ふたりの愛を誓う熱いベーゼを……！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Well, okay. As much as I'm enjoying this, it's outside
the scope of this experiment. Let me help you out.
May the chains of passion be shattered forthwith!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね。
いいところなんだけど、
これ以上は実験の範疇じゃないか。
今解除してあげる……
ここに汝らを魔法の楔より解き放たん！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. What's going on? Where am I...?
And you! Who might you be?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あら。
私ったら、
何を……？
あなた、
どちら様……？

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Oh no, look at the time! I need to finish my shopping!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やだ、
もうこんな時間？　
早く買い物に行かなくちゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they've all come to their senses. If it had gone on
much longer, I'd have feared for your innocence.
Guess we stopped it just in time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな正気に戻って、散っていったわね。
もう少し遅かったら貞操の危機だったけど、
間に合って良かった。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
It's funny, though...
Whenever one of them tried to kiss you, I had the strangest
urge to reverse the spell, no matter who they were...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでかしらね。
相手が誰でも、
君がキスされそうなのを見てたら、
なんとなくすぐに解除したくなっちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Could it be? I know I said it was a joke before, but...
Perhaps I really am in love with...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかしたら……
さっきは冗談だって言ったけど、
私、
本気であなたのこと……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding.
Good work out there today. Let's go home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんてね。
今日はお疲れさま。
帰りましょう。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe... Why don't you tell me? Try to work it out!
If you guess right, I'll give you something really special...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ……
どっちかしら？　
当ててみて♪
正解したら、
とってもいいものをあげるわよ……？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And so saying, with a subtle smile on her face,
Mitsuki turned and walked away.
text_block_list.orig_text: そう微笑んで、ミツキは去っていくのだった。
